title: eludite.git.diff input
description: The diff of one file (Compare with Unmodified, Ctrl+D in the Workspace window; a double-click in Git Changes): its working-tree text against the index (the default), HEAD or a revision; with `staged`, the index's text against HEAD (or the revision). Lines are compared as the editor's own diff compares them (Myers' algorithm, bounded, so a wholesale rewrite reads as all removed then all added). The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.

path.description: Relative to the repository root, or absolute inside its working tree.

against.description: `index` (default), `head`, or a revision (`HEAD~2`, a branch, a commit id).

staged.description: Diff the index's text (not the working tree's). Default false.

context.description: Lines of context around each change. Default 3.

max_lines.description: Changed lines listed at most (the rest are counted in `omitted`). Default and maximum 2000.
